positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: SOL remains the only major with a differentiated positive catalyst: spot Solana ETFs keep posting net inflows (cumulative >$1.12B since launch; a recent 7-day streak ~$39M) even as spot BTC funds stay in an outflow regime, and on-chain demand is visible in fresh whale accumulation (a dormant wallet reactivated to buy ~67,648 SOL/~$6.2M). Infrastructure runway is intact (Firedancer at ~207 validators; Alpenglow sub-150ms finality on the runway). On a broad risk-off tape (renewed US-Iran tensions + Fed on hold) SOL is down ~2.5% on the day vs BTC ~-3.25% / ETH ~-3.2% — modest but real relative strength from its independent flow bid. Canonical price 72.80 (dashboard Yahoo feed, asOf 2026-08-01T11:57:42Z).
positions.driver: Closed prior SOL at 72.80 (canonical dashboard feed) for -115.13 (entry 73.61); SOL was ~flat/soft vs entry as the whole tape sold off. Re-selected SOL as the best risk-adjusted next-24h pick: it is the only major carrying an active idiosyncratic catalyst (persistent spot-ETF inflows + whale accumulation + Firedancer/Alpenglow) AND it is outperforming on the down day (-2.5% vs BTC/ETH ~-3.2%). Wins vs runners-up: BTC (~63,016) is the max-downside-protection major but sits mid ETF-outflow with no fresh catalyst; ETH (~1,865) is soft with no differentiated driver. Close & re-entry are on the SAME canonical basis (72.80) so this is a clean rotation-in-place with no phantom P&L. DATA NOTE: the dashboard proxy served stale CDN shards on first pulls (asOf 07-19/07-26/07-31); a cache-busted request returned fresh data asOf 2026-08-01T11:57:42Z matching the moonshot-all run (BTC 63,010 @ 11:40) and the news tape. Third-party exchange prints (Kraken SOL ~97, Coinbase SOL ~86) were rejected as spurious outliers vs the canonical ~72.8. 10% stop keeps the higher-beta payoff asymmetric.
positions.risks: Thesis is catalyst/flow-dependent, not a momentum breakout: any single-day break in the ETF-inflow streak removes SOL's core edge. A deepening risk-off (further Iran escalation, accelerating BTC ETF outflows) can drag high-beta SOL down despite its independent bid; a decisive loss of the ~$70 shelf would signal the flow bid is failing. Hard stop 65.52 (-10%) caps downside while leaving room for normal alt chop.
